title.narrative: Asociación de Mujeres Afrodescendientes del Norte del Cauca ASOM

description.narrative: The Association of Afro-descendant Women of Northern Cauca (ASOM) is an organization formed by 10 groups of women from different areas with the participation of 220 associated women. ASOM was founded from spaces for meeting and reflection generated autonomously by women from the Northern Cauca region. Its mission is to strengthen the participation and organization of women, as well as the appreciation and recognition of the role played by them in the spaces and social processes of change that the country requires. The grant will support the following specific priorities:- Organizational development- Attention to women victims of gender-based violence- Strengthening the economic autonomy of women- Strengthening individual and collective capacities- Strengthening advocacy actions
